entries.title: Persuasion: Why Is Charles Hayter Jealous?
entries.hook: Henrietta once cared about Charles Hayter. What changed?

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Before Captain Wentworth arrived, Henrietta seemed strongly attached to Charles Hayter. After Wentworth became a daily visitor, Charles returned to find her manners greatly altered.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Charles believes Captain Wentworth is the probable cause of that change.

entries.prompt: Who does Charles see as his rival?
entries.visualBrief: Bright romantic anime Regency drawing room with an adult young woman between two adult gentlemen at a respectful distance, expressive faces, hands hidden, rose blue and gold palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Return an Item in Clear English
entries.hook: A clear return request needs three facts.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: I bought this desk lamp yesterday, but it will not switch on. I tried two sockets.

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: Do you have the receipt, and would you prefer a refund or exchange?

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: Yes. I have the receipt, and I’d like an exchange, please.

entries.prompt: What three facts did Mia give?
entries.answer: The item, the problem, and the result she wants.
entries.visualBrief: Cheerful bright anime shop counter with two adult people discussing a boxed desk lamp, upper bodies only, hands below frame, blue yellow and cream palette, no readable text.

entries.title: Refund or Exchange: Catch the Final Choice
entries.hook: The customer asks for a refund, but does she keep that choice?

turns.speaker: leo
turns.text: A card refund takes three to five working days, but I can exchange the lamp immediately.

turns.speaker: mia
turns.text: In that case, I’ll exchange it. I need a working lamp tonight.

entries.visualBrief: Polished bright anime retail scene with an adult woman comparing a refund card symbol and replacement lamp box, hands hidden, coral navy and warm yellow, no readable text.

entries.title: Persuasion: Wentworth Helps Anne in Silence
entries.hook: One small kindness leaves Anne unable to speak.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Little Walter climbs onto Anne while she cares for his sick brother. She orders and pleads, but cannot make him move.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Captain Wentworth silently lifts the child away. He makes noise with Walter as if he means to avoid hearing Anne thank him.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: The kindness and the distance together leave Anne painfully overcome.

entries.prompt: Why can Anne not thank him?
entries.answer: His quiet kindness awakens powerful, conflicting feelings.
entries.visualBrief: Emotional bright anime Regency interior showing adult Anne seated beside a child while an adult naval captain quietly helps, sensitive expressions, anatomically correct hands mostly out of frame, blue rose and cream palette, no readable text.
